messages.content: What is the capital of France?

usage.outputShape: body.response (string) — expected to hold search results, but on the tested run returned the literal error string "X402 Service is currently unavailable."
quirks: Charge-then-fail: returned HTTP 201 and DEBITED $0.10 USDC but the body was {"response":"X402 Service is currently unavailable."} — payment was taken with no actual search result.
The QuestFlow x402 agent gateway accepts payment before the underlying service responds, so a 201 status does NOT mean success — you must inspect body.response for the error string.
Do NOT retry on the unavailable message — money is lost per attempt with no result.
usage.guide: This QuestFlow x402 agent gateway for Jina web search is currently broken. A POST with body {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<query>"}]} returns HTTP 201 and charges ~$0.10 USDC, but the body comes back {"response":"X402 Service is currently unavailable."} instead of search results. The underlying X402 service is down — payment is taken with no usable output. Do not call this endpoint until it is re-verified; you will lose money for nothing.
